goal.statement: A trustworthy, directly usable read-only efficiency observation module: every record scoped to the declared project/window, unknown never turned into zero, declared bounds enforced before parsing, streaming response budgets, and a stable summary plus sanitized report.
goal.blockedPilot: E original 24turn/200000token/USD5 single-in-flight pilot remains BLOCKED; G did not reset, top up, refund, replace samples or research new pricing/recipes.
goal.defaultUiAdmission: Not requested and not granted: main has not connected G metrics to the default UI, and G does not depend on that. F can run without metrics.

phases.result: outcomes, work evidence, work history and attention are all constrained by the declared projects and the requested window; work entries are filtered by entry.at; attention pages from other projects, the future or outside the freshness window are refused or downgraded

per-source losses (seen/accepted/notParsed/invalid/conflicted/outOfScope/outsideWindow/unmapped) propagate to source coverage and metric unknownCount; workEvidence=[{}] yields null/partial/unknown rather than 0/complete

maxRecords/maxWorks/maxPages applied before parsing; records past the bound are never validated; an exact fit is complete, not truncated; collector truncation is reported as stoppedBy=source; the CLI validates type and size before reading
response bodies are read as a stream against the remaining budget and cancelled on overflow; failures report bytesReceived/declaredLength; error and redirect bodies are bounded to 16KB
two-project controlled product runtime driven through the real command surface; the collector writes a product-sourced workIndex and stamps capturedAt after reading
real question/answer/acceptance/verification facts and the product's own ReviewTiming are read from the same subject; usage stays unknown because the controlled execution records none
the collected bundle is written to a new 0600 file, re-read by analyze/verify, reproduces the same summary id, and verify --expect-digest refuses changed bytes
second runnable result: one two-project chain from real public reads to a bounded collection, verified file, pure API/CLI and readable report, with per-metric available/unknown listed
toInsightConsumerView adds an explicit partial flag and refuses ready when records were quarantined; bounded-but-legal observations stay ready with partial=true; unknown stays null
reports lead with project/window/coverage/samples, carry a per-source loss table, cite record-level provenance ids, separate layers/currencies and escape untrusted text
collect/analyze/report/verify/help share argument, path, window, timezone, limit and exit semantics; exclusive 0600 output; bounded errors with bytesReceived; no token/header/body leakage
third runnable result: stable package API and types, real same-source sample, partial/unknown conventions and CLI tooling handed to main/F

daily workflow: repeat observation of the same window does not double count; an earlier window reports a known zero for the same works with the excluded facts accounted for; reports are exclusive and never overwritten
bounded performance and fault regression: 4500 outcomes across three layers, 200 works under maxWorks, 40 pages under maxPages, 1000 quarantined records, 30 currencies, plus 16 HTTP adapter negatives
package/tools/reports documentation updated for range rules, limits-before-parsing, streaming budgets, workIndex, losses, partial consumer semantics and troubleshooting

exitCodes.0: complete observation (every declared source fully enumerated, no quarantine)
exitCodes.3: partial: bounded/truncated source, quarantined records or a declared analysis bound
exitCodes.4: insufficient data: source missing or not collected
exitCodes.5: source unavailable, digest mismatch/pin mismatch, redirect refusal, streaming budget exceeded or output not writable

observation.source: real controlled product runtime (two projects) behind the real HTTP read app on 127.0.0.1

attention.meaning: current pending-age snapshot after both works were accepted

scope: entry before the window is not counted
unknown: mixed valid+bad keeps known counts and adds unknown
empty complete set is the only measured zero
limits: maxRecords=1 accepts 1 and reports 1 not parsed
record past the bound is never validated
streaming: unknown-length 131072 bytes aborts mid-stream under a 1024-byte budget
declared oversized Content-Length refused before reading
short-framed body refused as bad schema
trickling stream times out with progress

bounds.notes: in-process pure analysis plus local adapter tests; timings are short bounded checks, not a soak or cross-machine guarantee

consumer.projection: toInsightConsumerView (structurally identical to apps/console/src/trial/insights.ts TrialInsightsView, plus an explicit partial flag)
consumer.compatibility: usage-insights/1 additive-only; null means unknown and is never defaulted to 0
mainIntegrationNeeded: render of the partial flag by the trial UI
root import/export wiring if the console consumes it directly

notReached: actual_native execution data: NOT_TESTED — the probe runs the controlled fixture driver; no vendor model or native turn was performed and no native sample was fabricated
operator production instance: NOT_ATTEMPTED — no operator credential was available; the tool supports it via --base-url/--token-file
real operator baseline: none supplied; the example baseline is illustrative only
queue.waitMs over real data: the product read surface exposes no queued/dispatched endpoint pair
execution.durationMs over real data: the controlled fixture driver records no duration on the outcome
known token/cost usage: the controlled execution records none, so usage is unknown rather than zero
long-running stability, cross-machine performance and 48h soak: out of scope
limitations: All numbers are observations of recorded facts. Nothing here proves saved hours, efficiency gains, causality or quality.
Interaction metrics are product-record counts; they carry no evidence layer and are not execution evidence.
review.activeMs is a partial UI-visibility proxy, clipped by the real ready→accepted interval; it is never human working time.
Unknown usage and unknown cost stay unknown; prices are not looked up and currencies are never combined.
A bundle retains product record detail (for example work titles) and is a private 0600 input; only generated reports are sanitized for sharing.
Reporting on a production instance would require that instance's own credential; G does not discover or reuse credentials.
